profile.headline: Contractor at Apple as a Software Engineer
profile.jobTitle: Contractor at Apple as a Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm from Dallas, TX striving to innovate great solutions to modern-day problems. I specialize in development, but any activity requiring problem solving and creative thinking is where you will find me.

positions.title: Contractor at Apple as a Software Engineer
Application Developer
positions.description:
• Responsible for the Analysis and Design of the software applications and integrated computer systems
• Understand and participate in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including analysis, design, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting.
• Developed software using established best practices, test driven design, code quality in a highly collaborative team environment
• Work closely with the senior or lead developer to ensure understanding of user stories, acceptance criteria, as well as technical implementation to achieve the Definition of Ready (DoR) to Definition of Done (DoD)
• Worked on any other related task whenever necessary.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Pac-Clone - Personal Developed App  Sept-2019
React|Axios|Express|NodeJs|CSS|Stripe||PostgreSQL
Ecommerce site where user can look,search, and purchase items.
● User can Look through all items with functional Search Component.
● Integrated Stripe so user can test purchasing items.
● Integrated Redux so the component tree is easy to manage.
● Developed User-Item’s Tables in Postgresql

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
DineNow 
*Find nearest restaurants using ur GPS location
* search for restaurants in any city or state you want using the Zomato API
*Call, Check menu, check the address, and even check amenities in the restaurant

positions.title: Roomers
positions.description:
Roomers is a full stack web application that allows people to either look for a roommate or post their home if they are in need of a roommate.

- Wireframed the front-end on Invision and kept track of all goals on Trello
- Held daily stand-ups with a group of 5 in order to coordinate tasks
- Implemented 2 front-end flows, one for owners and one for residents
- Built RESTful APIs to handle the application's data flow through the use of multiple controllers

Technologies and Packages: React, React Router, Redux, Redux Promise Middleware, Node, Express, Express Session, Massive, MongoDB, Socket.io,AWS.

positions.title: DigitalBuy-E-commerce for electronics
positions.description:
Check the mobile version on your phones at www.digitalbuy.net

Created this mobile application after learning React for about one month and a half
Technologies I used were: React, Redux, NodeJS, Express, Massive, PostgreSQL, styled with styled components and CSS.

positions.title: Land Surveyor
positions.description:
Applied civil engineering principles, practices, and methods pertaining to the conduct of property, topographic, construction, and related surveying.
Helped determine precise location and measurements of points, elevations, lines, areas and dredging contours to A.C.O.E. standards.
Performed Boundary Surveys, Topo’s and Bathymetric Surveys.
Determined methods and procedures for establishing and reestablishing survey control.
Kept accurate notes, records and sketches to describe and certify work performed.
Coordinated findings with work of engineering and architectural personnel, clients and others concerned with project.

positions.title: Panel Relationship agent
positions.description:
Collected and maintained demographic and device information via outbound and inbound calls to ensure quality of the data.Used recruitment resources effectively and is able to present full disclosure of participation guidelines to panelists.
Investigated and resolved proprietary system generated panelist performance issues.

positions.title: Service Desk Specialist
positions.description: Provided frontline EIT support to T-Mobile employees. This included resolving and providing first tier support such as Advancements in job functions including permission and job title. Handled resolutions to problems to systems such as SAMSON POS and VPN.Escalated events such as Internet and site outages to local ITA.Kept records of all information through ticketing system remedy.

projects.title: League-Lookup
projects.description:
React|Styled components|Riot API|Axios|Express|NodeJs|CSS
Application where you can check your and others league accounts find data like rank,past games and live game data
Used Riot’s api brought it to backend Express server to create different methods to pull to front end.
Used styled components-css to style different components in React.
Combined different riot endpoints to pull in desired account data.
Created endpoint where user can pull in during a live match, his different opponents his facing.
